FsmRegisterFinding.description: One state register's illegal-encoding result in a [`Btor2CheckFsmResponse`].

illegal_encoding_reachable.description: `true` when an illegal encoding is reachable (a finding).

legal_encodings.description: The legal encodings the register's own logic recognizes (sorted).

verdict.description: Canonical verdict — `"holds"` (stays within its encoding) | `"violated"` (an illegal encoding is reachable) | `"unknown"` (the portfolio could not decide).

fsm_registers_checked.description: Number of FSM-like state registers scanned.

illegal_encodings_found.description: Number of registers with a reachable illegal encoding (`verdict == "violated"`).
